channels.name: Serial lane (TX/RX differential pair)
channels.purpose: Carry 8b/10b or 64b/66b encoded packets between ports.
channels.active_levels: differential serial, 2.5-100 Gbps/lane (SDR..NDR), NRZ or PAM4

channels.name: Virtual Lane (logical)
channels.purpose: Independent buffered lane (VL0..VL14 data, VL15 management) for QoS / deadlock avoidance.
channels.active_levels: selected by SL-to-VL mapping; shared by VL arbitration

handshake_pairs.name: Credit-flow-control
handshake_pairs.rule: per-VL absolute credit advertisement gates transmission.

handshake_pairs.name: PSN-ACK-NAK
handshake_pairs.rule: reliable QP acknowledges/NAKs by PSN; retransmit on loss.

handshake_pairs.name: verbs-WQE
handshake_pairs.rule: post Work Requests to the Send/Receive Queue; reap CQEs.

handshake_pairs.name: SM-SMP
handshake_pairs.rule: assign LID, program forwarding tables over QP0/VL15.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Packets carry an LRH (always) and a GRH only when crossing subnets; transport packets carry a BTH. Switches forward by DLID, routers by DGID. The SM must have assigned LIDs and configured VLs before data flows.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Transmission on a VL requires available credits; reliable delivery requires PSN-based ACK/NAK; the QP must be in RTS (send) / RTR (receive).

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active packet
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: LRH|(GRH)|BTH|payload|ICRC|VCRC on a data VL, subject to credits and VL arbitration.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Management packet
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: SMP on VL15 (QP0) — not flow controlled.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Serial per lane; multi-lane (4x/12x) striped and de-skewed; 8b/10b or 64b/66b coded.
ordering_rules.packet_order: PSN orders packets within a message on a reliable QP; First/Middle/Last/Only segments reassemble in order.
ordering_rules.vl_interleave: VL arbitration interleaves packets of different VLs on the shared link.
